about: The target folder of every file of services/api/src (Syzygy ADR-0008 §6), applied wave by wave by scripts/layout/apply.mjs. A move keeps the basename; only the folder changes. Entry files stay at the root. scripts/check-api-layers.mjs reads this map to check the layout rules on the projected layout before the files move. A file added later that is not listed here is checked where it is.
entriesWhy: Run by a systemd unit (deploy/azure), the Agent Host plist (deploy/macos) or a services/api/package.json script; they stay at the src root.
pathDataFilesWhy: Their services/api/src paths are evidence a check verifies (scripts/check-product-spec.mjs), so a wave rewrites them like the core map.

waves.2: mind/memory, mind/recall, mind/sleep, mind/prediction, mind/emotion, and infra/sqlite with the memory stores
waves.5: mind/action/ownTime and wiring/, with infra/config and mind/self; check-api-layers switches to --enforce here
waves.6: infra/http (with apiKernel), infra/models (chatModel*), surfaces/text, infra/auth, mind/action/respond, mind/selectors
waves.7: Syzygy ADR-0008 stage 3, S2 and S3: stores split out, decisions out of the surfaces (applied by hand, file by file; the core set only widens)
